title: Reported Statements
description: Learn to report what someone said using indirect speech

explain.ta: Reported speech (அல்லது indirect speech) என்பது யாரோ சொன்னதை மறுபடியும் சொல்வது. Direct speech-ல் இருந்து reported speech-க்கு மாற்றும்போது tense பின்னோக்கி மாறும் (backshift). Present → Past, Past → Past Perfect. 'He said that...' என்று ஆரம்பிக்கிறோம். Pronouns மற்றும் time expressions மாறும். Direct: 'I am tired' → Reported: 'He said he was tired'. 'That' என்பது optional ஆனால் formal writing-ல் பயன்படுத்துவது நல்லது.
explain.en: Reported speech (or indirect speech) is when we tell someone what another person said. When converting from direct to reported speech, the tense shifts back (backshift). Present → Past, Past → Past Perfect. We start with 'He/She said that...'. Pronouns and time expressions change. Direct: 'I am tired' → Reported: 'He said he was tired'. The word 'that' is optional but commonly used in formal writing. This is essential for conveying conversations and information accurately.

examples: 'I am happy' → He said he was happy
'I work here' → She said she worked there
'I like it' → He said he liked it
'I am reading' → She said she was reading
'They are coming' → He said they were coming
'I am working' → She said she was working
'I went home' → He said he had gone home
'I saw it' → She said she had seen it
'I finished' → He said he had finished
'I will come' → He said he would come
'I will help' → She said she would help
'I will call' → He said he would call

examples.en: Direct: 'I am tired.' Reported: He said he was tired.
examples.ta: நேரடி: 'நான் சோர்வாக இருக்கிறேன்.' மறைமுக: அவர் சோர்வாக இருந்ததாக கூறினார்.

examples.en: Direct: 'I live in Chennai.' Reported: She said she lived in Chennai.
examples.ta: நேரடி: 'நான் சென்னையில் வசிக்கிறேன்.' மறைமுக: அவள் சென்னையில் வசித்ததாக கூறினாள்.

examples.en: Direct: 'I am studying English.' Reported: He said he was studying English.
examples.ta: நேரடி: 'நான் ஆங்கிலம் படிக்கிறேன்.' மறைமுக: அவர் ஆங்கிலம் படித்துக் கொண்டிருந்ததாக கூறினார்.

examples.en: Direct: 'I went to the market.' Reported: She said she had gone to the market.
examples.ta: நேரடி: 'நான் சந்தைக்கு சென்றேன்.' மறைமுக: அவள் சந்தைக்கு சென்றிருந்ததாக கூறினாள்.

examples.en: Direct: 'I will call you tomorrow.' Reported: He said he would call me tomorrow.
examples.ta: நேரடி: 'நான் நாளை உங்களை அழைப்பேன்.' மறைமுக: அவர் நாளை என்னை அழைப்பார் என்று கூறினார்.

examples.en: Direct: 'I don't like coffee.' Reported: She said she didn't like coffee.
examples.ta: நேரடி: 'எனக்கு காபி பிடிக்காது.' மறைமுக: அவளுக்கு காபி பிடிக்காது என்று கூறினாள்.

examples.en: Direct: 'I have finished my work.' Reported: He said he had finished his work.
examples.ta: நேரடி: 'நான் என் வேலையை முடித்துவிட்டேன்.' மறைமுக: அவர் தன் வேலையை முடித்திருந்ததாக கூறினார்.

examples.en: Direct: 'I can swim.' Reported: She said she could swim.
examples.ta: நேரடி: 'என்னால் நீந்த முடியும்.' மறைமுக: அவளால் நீந்த முடியும் என்று கூறினாள்.

examples.en: Direct: 'I am not feeling well.' Reported: He said he was not feeling well.
examples.ta: நேரடி: 'எனக்கு உடல்நிலை சரியில்லை.' மறைமுக: அவருக்கு உடல்நிலை சரியில்லை என்று கூறினார்.

listeningQuestions.audioText: She said she was happy with the results.
options: She said she was happy with the results.
She said she is happy with the results.
She says she was happy with the results.

listeningQuestions.audioText: He said he would come to the party.
options: He said he will come to the party.
He said he would come to the party.
He says he would come to the party.

listeningQuestions.audioText: They said they had seen the movie before.
options: They said they saw the movie before.
They said they have seen the movie before.
They said they had seen the movie before.

speakSentences.en: She said she was learning to drive.
speakSentences.ta: அவள் வாகனம் ஓட்ட கற்றுக் கொண்டிருந்ததாக கூறினாள்.

speakSentences.en: He said he had visited India last year.
speakSentences.ta: அவர் கடந்த ஆண்டு இந்தியா சென்றிருந்ததாக கூறினார்.

speakSentences.en: They said they would help us with the project.
speakSentences.ta: அவர்கள் திட்டத்தில் எங்களுக்கு உதவுவார்கள் என்று கூறினார்கள்.
